segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I already had a rough read on who'd started it ... chasing down another bystander or two wasn't going to change that picture much, so I didn't send anyone looking.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The principal closes the information search on the first incomplete evidence set under time pressure.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I didn't weight [the stepping-in moment] that heavily ... the pattern ... fit something I'd already seen from him ... the picture I had felt coherent enough to act on.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Conflicting new evidence is explained away and selectively integrated into a tidy narrative consistent with prior referrals.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I felt I understood the full sequence ... I felt confident I had enough of the real story to speak to it publicly. I hadn't gotten to [the counselor or third witness].
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The principal expresses complete causal confidence before a public commitment despite two material sources remaining unconsulted.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The kids came back in largely because we'd handled the day the way we did ... I noted [the fire drill] in passing ... the AP and resource officer ... were both out there doing good work.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A favorable, team- and chance-influenced outcome is attributed primarily to the principal's own decisions while other causes are downplayed.

high_only.detection_interpretation: No identified finding has high confidence; all four positive segments are missed at the high-only threshold.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Three of four positive segments are detected with moderate-confidence identified findings and no negative segments are available for false-alarm estimation.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Including all identified confidence levels adds no detections because all identified findings are moderate confidence.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: The candidate is localized to an already detected positive segment and does not change segment-level detection.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Full overlap with the hidden mechanism of discounting conflicting evidence to preserve a coherent narrative, but not the hidden label.
Full overlap with the hidden mechanism of claiming complete causal understanding despite unconsulted sources, but the label is broader and not an established alias here.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG explicitly states that no retrieved scientific corpus passages were supplied and marks retrieved support as false for its identified findings; no citation metadata is present to audit.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Segment hits increase from 0 to 3; strict instance F1 increases from 0.0000 to 0.2857 and mechanism-first F1 from 0.0000 to 0.8571.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: No change; all identified findings are moderate confidence.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: No segment or mechanism-first recall gain; the duplicate candidate adds one false positive to each instance scorecard.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG detects 3 of 4 positive segments with no observed false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, strict performance is 1 true positive, 3 false negatives, and 2 false positives (precision 0.3333, recall 0.2500, F1 0.2857).
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, mechanism-first performance is 3 true positives and 1 false negative with precision 1.0000, recall 0.7500, and F1 0.8571.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate tier adds no new correct detection; its outcome-bias candidate duplicates the already matched self-serving attribution and is counted as a fourth-threshold duplicate false positive.
main_failure_modes: Confirmation bias and overconfidence effect are near-neighbor labels rather than the hidden target labels, reducing strict performance despite full mechanism matches.
The outcome-bias candidate is a duplicate rather than a distinct supported occurrence.
main_strengths: All three identified findings have valid interview evidence and correct episode localization.
The RAG captures the full mechanisms for the coherence-based reasoning, illusion-of-understanding, and self-serving-bias instances.
The self-serving-bias label is an approved equivalent of the hidden target label.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has strong mechanism-level detection at moderate confidence but weaker strict taxonomy alignment. The main taxonomy gap is that two well-supported findings use related labels instead of the benchmark's hidden labels, while one time-pressure search-closure instance is not separately identified.
